# @clockworklabs/spacetimedb-sdk (deprecated)

This package is deprecated. Use `spacetimedb` instead.

## Install

npm i spacetimedb

## Migration

Change imports:

- From: `@clockworklabs/spacetimedb-sdk`
- To: `spacetimedb`

Example:

// before
import { Identity } from "@clockworklabs/spacetimedb-sdk";

// after
import { Identity } from "spacetimedb";
